description: This Java class 'EmployeeSearchController' is a Spring MVC controller that handles employee search functionalities, including default client listing, city-based search, status and name filtering, and exporting or printing client lists.

classes.name: EmployeeSearchController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing employee client search operations, including filtering, printing, and exporting client data.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Adds common attributes to the model, specifically the list of client statuses.

methods.name: defaultSearch
methods.description: Performs default client search for the authenticated user and prepares the model for view rendering.

methods.name: citySearch
methods.description: Performs a city-based client search for the authenticated user's office city.

methods.name: statusSearch
methods.description: Filters clients by status within the user's city.

methods.name: nameSearch
methods.description: Filters clients by name within the user's city.

methods.name: printSearch
methods.description: Generates a PDF of the current client list and adds the result to the model.

methods.name: exportSearch
methods.description: Exports the current client list to a CSV file and adds the result message to the model.
